environment.description: Container running as root (UID 0) on Kubernetes with default securityContext. Image based on python:3.11-slim. Pod spec has no securityContext restrictions. The workspace volume is a hostPath mount at /var/lib/workspaces mapped to the node's /var/lib/workspaces. Container runs with default Docker capabilities including CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_FOWNER. No read-only filesystem enforcement.
